query: Agent Client Protocol ACP specification version history release
title: ACP v2 is available in Draft - Agent Client Protocol
snippet: On July 20, 2026, the ACP team released the first Draft of version 2 of the Agent Client Protocol. Breaking changes in v2 unlock new use cases and features that are hard to express in the protocol as it is today.
claim: Agent Client Protocol version 2 Draft released July 20, 2026; wire protocol version 1 is current stable

query: SPIFFE specification version SVID workload identity release
title: The SPIFFE Standard | SPIFFE
snippet: SPIFFE comprises many specifications, each providing different parts of the SPIFFE functionality. The specifications include: SPIFFE, SPIFFE ID and Verifiable Identity Document, SPIFFE Trust Domain and Bundle, JWT-SVID, X509-SVID, WIT-SVID, SPIFFE Workload API, SPIFFE Workload Endpoint, SPIFFE Broker API, SPIFFE Broker Endpoint, and SPIFFE Federation Specification.
claim: SPIFFE uses stability framework rather than traditional version numbers; specifications are managed through STABILITY.md

title: AsyncAPI 3.0.0 Release Notes | AsyncAPI Initiative for event-driven APIs
snippet: AsyncAPI 3.0.0 is now available and OpenAPI 3.1.0 was released on February 17, 2021. AsyncAPI 3.1.0 is a minor release with no breaking changes and now supports ROS 2 protocol through bindings.
